from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial record extracted from a single document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name from this document")
    is_target_company: bool | None = Field(description="True if this document's company matches the target company from the task")
    asset_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the asset item as written in the document")
    asset_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the asset, if available")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this data covers")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
